race.comment: READY SET TERGO (3) was doing his best work late on debut at Doomben two weeks ago, forced to cover more ground out wide when letting down with his run. Is drawn to get back again but he has clear scope for improvement and with even luck he'll be fighting out the finish. JIMMY THE SCAT (1) beat him home on debut and only missed the winner by a head at big odds. Tougher this time under the big weight and from the unkind draw, but he deserves respect. VICE ROYAL (11) is an I Am Invincible gelding on debut for the Gollan camp that has come along nicely in his lead-up work and keeps A Jones aboard. Can make a bright start. VOLCANIC RUSH (6) is another debutant that has been trialled strongly and comes into the mix after a key scratching. Market support will be telling.
